Hi Connor — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) Deploy sandbox: we’ll provision the trial cluster and share credentials (ETA: 48 hours) — action: Sergio
2) Data pipeline: your infra team confirmed S3 access (need bucket path + IAM role) — action: Novus
3) Security review: you mentioned SOC2 evidence would be required before GA data flows — action: Novus
4) Health check: schedule a 30-min walkthrough once the cluster is up to validate token usage and KV cache behavior — action: Sergio/LA

Attaching a lightweight onboarding checklist (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf) with the minimum items that unblock a trial run. If SOC2 artifacts are the gating item, let me know which specific docs the security reviewers want and I’ll pull them. 

Proposed times for the walkthrough next week: Tue 11/3 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 11/4 14:00–14:30 PT — tell me what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
